articles.title: Janet Corrigan, 63, Machinist
articles.deck: Friends remember Janet Corrigan for the many years of service to Eastgate.
body: Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Eastgate.

Born in Eastgate in the years after the war, Janet Corrigan spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Lower Millrace Improvement Group in his or her name.
Janet Corrigan died in July at home on Quarry Court, at the age of 63. Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Eastgate.

articles.title: Letter: the Hickory Ridge Recreation Center Did a Good Job This Winter
body: To the editor: I have lived on Lilac Street for 26 years, and I want to say what a difference the Hickory Ridge Recreation Center has made. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Please keep the Saturday cleanup day in the budget. Many of us on Lilac Street use it every week. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the November meeting.
Hal Wojcik, Tannery Flats

articles.title: Eastgate Asks Council for Speed Limit Change
articles.deck: Supporters and opponents on Rowan Court disagreed about cost and timing.
body: Public works estimates the work will take about 6 weeks once it starts in January. Councilmember Simone Emerson asked for more time to review the proposal, which would cost about $48,000.

Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days. Residents of Eastgate said they had been asking for action for years, and several brought photographs of the street.
The ordinance will return to the agenda at the next regular session, unless the chair calls a special meeting first. Public works estimates the work will take about 6 weeks once it starts in January.
